rule: R-ENF-01 / a numbers file with two generators declares their order
note: EMPTY ON ADOPTION, deliberately. The three studies this gate governs — EGCH, SAVOLA and SWDY — were declared the same morning the defect was found, so there is no debt to carry. An empty ratchet is the GOAL STATE of a list that may only shorten, not a sign the gate does nothing: its negative control goes red on seven conditions, and case 7 protects the classification this gate’s author got wrong twice.
